notes:
Local runs only (colima 0.10.3 VM, Docker 29.5.2 linux/arm64, kind v0.33.0, helm v4.3.0, kubeconform v0.8.0, kubectl v1.37.1). No GitHub Actions run: every deploy-pack.yml job is pending-ci (README.md). The receipt commit is the head the checks, the static steps and the clean verifier run used; the kind lifecycle and both drills ran at 0c8fa7365, and only this receipt's README changed after it. The branch base is 691a041dc; int has since moved.
Non-zero exits, all expected or explained: (1) negative renders against chart 0.1.0 exit 1 by design. (2) deploy-verify.mjs --target http://127.0.0.1:1 and credentials-presence-check.mjs --json with an empty HOME exit 1: the spec's fail-closed negatives, no values printed. (3) The drill with image A from origin/main exit 1 at probe-a verify: main's Studio still runs the complete-ledger check, which its own live gateway session fails; the same drill with image A from 8c4bc10ec passes all six steps. (4) The full vitest suite exit 1: 107 failed of 23,196 (10 skipped by a hook timeout under load), every failing file also fails on 691a041dc with the same or a higher count (checked in a scratch worktree); studioNativeTaskService fails on this host on 691a041dc too.
Verify fix: Studio's native verify returns the separate state anchored-prefix (probe status verified-prefix) when the task's session is closed and sealed, every row and sealed session verifies, the monitor key is pinned, and the only unfinalized sessions are named unended legacy sessions (the running gateway's); it never reports externally-anchored for that and never sets ok. Both kind helm tests and every post-fix drill probe reached verified-prefix.
tests: the 15 S1 and S2 vitest files in the static job at the receipt commit. Mutations M1-M22 all killed (mutations.json).
A durationMs of 0 means the command was not timed (the cherry-pick, the equivalence diff, the mutation runner, whose per-mutation timings are in mutations.json, and the OpenAPI --check).
